responsibility: This file is the top-level parser driver for gfortran. It decodes incoming statements based on parser state, coordinates statement matching and rollback, manages the compilation-state stack and program-unit nesting, applies queued USE statements at the right time, constructs namespace and code trees for complete program units, and after parsing orchestrates whole-unit resolution, OpenMP/OpenACC postprocessing, optional dumps/prototype emission, and final translation of all parsed namespaces.
same_name_distinction: Implements the parser itself: statement decoding, state-stack manipulation, program-unit construction, resolution/translation orchestration, and helper logic like USE processing. Unlike gcc/fortran/parse.h, this is the executable parser driver rather than the shared definitions of parser states, stack records, and parser-support declarations.
